text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Deputy premier Tareq Aziz urges the U.N. General Assembly meeting on environment to lift sanctions on Iraq in order to improve environment in Iraq.
- U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan says he will exert efforts to speed up implementation of the oil-for-food deal.
- Ambassador Richard Butler, new chairman of the U.N. Special Commission overseeing elimination of Iraq's prohibited weapons, says he will work with objectivity.
- Foreign Minister Mohammad Saeed al-Sahaf lashes out at the concluding statement of the meeting of foreign ministers of Syria, Egypt and six oil-rich Gulf states held in Latakia, Syria.
(The above were also carried by IRAQ)
